clips.title: The story
paras: A Consecrated Rune is an inscribed sacred item passed to fledgling dwarven paladins training in Coldridge Valley. It serves as an introductory summons from Bromos Grummner, directing initiates to report to Anvilmar and begin their formal duties as Knights of the Silver Hand.

Novice dwarven paladins proving themselves in Coldridge Valley are handed a Consecrated Rune once they have shown basic martial competence. Inscribed with sacred words and blessed by the Holy Light, the rune originates from Bromos Grummner, the paladin trainer residing inside Anvilmar. Dwarves hold immense respect for the traditions of the Holy Light introduced to them by their human allies. Reading the rune serves as both an official summons and a symbolic rite of passage, confirming the novice's place among the Knights of the Silver Hand.
